readiness.hed: Frost advisory until 9 a.m., then sun and a high near 71.
readiness.insight: A frost advisory covers portions of central and northern Virginia until 9 a.m. this morning. The National Weather Service says temperatures as low as 33 can put frost on tender plants, and uncovered plants may be killed. The lowest readings are expected in valleys. Today turns sunny after the fog, with a high near 71 and a west wind of 0 to 3 mph. Tonight is mostly clear, low around 45.
actions: Cover tender plants before you leave; advisory runs until 9 a.m.
